title: Sitemap URL Extractor for SEO & AI Audits input
description: Add one or more website addresses or direct sitemap URLs, then click Start. The Actor finds the sitemaps, follows indexes and returns one row per page URL. You are charged per URL kept, so set Max URLs per site if you only need a sample.

startUrls.title: Websites or sitemap URLs
startUrls.description: Required. One per line: a website address (the sitemap is found through robots.txt, then common paths such as /sitemap.xml) or a direct sitemap, sitemap index or .xml.gz URL. Each line is processed as its own site. If a site has no sitemap, a warning is logged and nothing is charged for it.

maxUrlsPerSite.sectionDescription: Use these to cap cost and keep only the URLs you need. Filters run before results are saved, so dropped URLs are not charged.
maxUrlsPerSite.title: Max URLs per site
maxUrlsPerSite.description: Stop after this many page URLs per start URL. Whole number from 1 to 1,000,000, default 1,000. Raise it to get a full sitemap.

includeRegex.title: Include only URLs matching (regex)
includeRegex.description: Optional. A Python regular expression; only URLs that contain a match (re.search) are kept. Leave empty to keep all. An invalid expression stops the run with a message.

excludeRegex.title: Exclude URLs matching (regex)
excludeRegex.description: Optional. A Python regular expression; URLs that contain a match (re.search) are dropped. Applied together with the include filter. An invalid expression stops the run with a message.

modifiedSince.title: Only URLs modified since (YYYY-MM-DD)
modifiedSince.description: Optional. A date as YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps URLs whose lastmod date is on or after it; URLs with no lastmod are dropped when this is set. Leave empty for no date filter.

checkStatus.title: Check HTTP status of each URL
checkStatus.description: When on, sends a light HEAD request (GET if HEAD is refused) to every kept URL and fills statusCode and finalUrl. Slower, so leave it off unless you need it. Default off.

maxSitemaps.title: Max sitemap files per site
maxSitemaps.description: Safety cap on how many sitemap files are read for one start URL. Whole number from 1 to 10000, default 500.
